# end-of-software

> The seam, running: say what you need — it reuses the estate's 421 live folds, recombines them, or generates as a last resort; five human doors catch what must never auto-render; fold-back by default; the shadow remembers. Mechanism CC0, code MIT. Witness 38/40+2.

end-of-software is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.
